hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && status=$(git status --short) && printf 'Branch at the start of this turn: %s\nWorking tree: %s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)" "${status:-clean}"

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' | awk '/<<-?.?EOF/ {print; skip=1; next} skip && /^EOF$/ {skip=0; next} !skip'); printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'just +(test|verify|check|mutate)([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*(grep|head|tail|cut|wc)([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Write the output of just test, verify, check, or mutate to a file under /tmp and read that file with the Read tool, from the first failure or from the end: a filter can drop the line that matters (rule 6 of the TDD section in CLAUDE.md)."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^[[:space:]]*|[;&|][[:space:]]+|\$\()([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]]+)*(sudo[[:space:]]+|env[[:space:]]+|time[[:space:]]+|xargs[[:space:]]+)*(/?([[:alnum:]_.-]+/)*)?python(3[0-9.]*)?([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run anything you point at this repository with just py, which puts the package on the path, or with uv run where no recipe fits; never a python of its own, the system one or the one in .venv/bin (see the Running and rewriting code section of CLAUDE.md). To run Python in another directory, change to it and call just --justfile <repository>/justfile py."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'just +mutate( [^|;]*)?\|' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run just mutate unpiped: which tests killed the mutation is the evidence you are after, and a filter drops the lines that name them."}}' || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); first=$(printf '%s
' "$cmd" | head -1); last=$(printf '%s
' "$cmd" | tail -1); printf '%s
' "$first" | grep -qE "^just mutate [A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]+( just [a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?( > /tmp/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)?( 2>&1)?( <<'EOF')?( 2>&1)? *$" && { ! printf '%s
' "$first" | grep -qF "<<'EOF'" || [ "$last" = "EOF" ]; } && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"A mutation probe: it replaces one snippet, runs the command, and restores the file whatever happens."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'PYTHONPATH=src[[:space:]]+uv[[:space:]]+run' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run it with just py, which puts src on the path and runs through uv run (see the Running and rewriting code section of CLAUDE.md)."}}' || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]|[[:space:]])(grep|awk|head|tail|cut)[[:space:]][^;&|]*/tmp/[^[:space:]]*\.txt|/tmp/[^[:space:]]*\.txt[^;&]*\|[[:space:]]*(grep|awk|head|tail|cut)([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Read a report under /tmp with the Read tool, from the first failure or from the end, rather than through a filter: a filter can drop the line that matters. To find the end, wc -l the file and read from near there."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | grep -qE '[.]py$' && { out=$(just format-after-edit 2>&1) || jq -nc --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("The file was formatted; just format-after-edit then reported:\n" + $out)}}'; } || true
